title: Accounts Administrator
description:
Accounts Administrator
Office-Based
Free Parking

An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced Accounts Administrator to join a busy and growing finance team based in Stowmarket.

This is a varied and hands-on role, ideal for someone who enjoys working in a fast-paced environment, thrives on keeping processes organised, and takes pride in maintaining accurate financial records. With a strong focus on purchase ledger, you'll play a key role in supporting the day-to-day activities of the finance function.

If you're highly organised, detail-oriented, and enjoy working as part of a supportive team, we'd love to hear from you.

Duties:
- Processing high volumes of purchase invoices accurately and efficiently
- Supporting the day-to-day management of the purchase ledger
- Maintaining and reconciling supplier accounts
- Investigating and resolving invoice and account queries
- Liaising with suppliers, customers, and internal departments
- Assisting with payment runs and account reconciliations
- Maintaining accurate financial records and documentation

This is a busy and varied position where attention to detail is essential. You'll be trusted to manage your workload effectively, take ownership of queries, and contribute to the smooth running of the finance department.

We're looking for an experienced accounts professional who is comfortable working in a high-volume environment and can hit the ground running.

You will ideally have:
- Previous purchase ledger experience
- Strong transactional accounts knowledge
- Experience processing large volumes of invoices
- Excellent accuracy and attention to detail
- Strong organisational and time-management skills

If you're an experienced Accounts Administrator looking for a new challenge within a busy and supportive finance team, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Accounts Support Administrator
description:
MacKenzie King are working with a successful, growing business based in Woolpit to find an organised and enthusiastic Accounts Support Administrator to join their supportive Accounts team.

This is a varied support role, providing day-to-day administrative and data support to their busy Accounts team. This role would suit someone with good administration and IT skills who is accurate, organised and interested in developing their knowledge and experience within an Accounts environment.

Previous accounts experience is not essential, as training and support will be provided.

Key tasks and responsibilities
- Inputting and updating data accurately on company systems and spreadsheets.
- Generating regular reports and providing information to the Accounts team.
- Checking and maintaining electronic records to ensure information is accurate and up to date.
- Processing and uploading documentation to the relevant systems.
- Assisting with general Accounts administration.
- Monitoring shared inboxes and responding to or directing routine enquiries.
- Answering incoming telephone calls and dealing with or directing queries appropriately.
- Liaising with colleagues and depots to obtain information and documentation.
- Assisting with customer and supplier documentation and routine queries.
- Supporting the team with data processing and other administrative tasks.
- Providing additional support during busy periods and holiday absence.
- Learning and developing an understanding of the wider Accounts function.

Qualifications and experience
- Previous administration or office-based experience
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Excel, Word and Outlook
- Confidence working with spreadsheets, systems and data
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy
- Good organisational skills and the ability to prioritise a varied workload
- Good written and verbal communication skills
- A professional and confident telephone manner
- A positive and helpful approach to teamwork
- A willingness to learn and develop

Development & Progression

As you gain experience and develop your knowledge, there will be opportunities to learn more about purchase ledger, sales ledger, credit control and wider financial administration, with the potential to progress into an Accounts Administrator role.

To find out more about this opportunity, please contact Ben at MacKenzie King.

title: Credit Controller
description:
MacKenzie King are working with a successful, growing business based in Woolpit to find an organised and proactive Credit Controller to join their supportive Accounts team. Previous experience working in a high-volume credit control department is essential as this position will be working as part of a small team handling credit control for locations across the UK, so being organised and used to managing a high-volume workload will also be essential. You will be responsible for chasing outstanding payments, running credit checks and screening for fraud risks, as well as collaborating with the depot manager.

Key tasks and responsibilities
- Overseeing high-density day-to-day accounts receivable, tracking payments, and actively managing cash collections across multiple businesses.
- Credit Checking & Risk Management: Conducting rigorous credit evaluations on new and existing contractors, setting appropriate credit limits, monitoring transactions for red flags, and identifying potential invoice fraud or unusual payment behaviours.
- Partnering with Sales & Operations: Working hand-in-hand with our sales teams and depot managers to onboard new clients smoothly, balance risk with revenue goals, and resolve billing disputes quickly to keep cash moving while nurturing strong customer relationships.
- Streamlining Cash Flow: Minimising Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) and running regular aging and risk reports for senior leadership.

Qualifications and experience
- Proven experience managing high-volume credit control or accounts receivable, ideally within the construction or a related project-based industry.
- Strong expertise in credit checking, financial risk mitigation, and fraud detection.
- Excellent interpersonal skills with a proven track record of partnering successfully with sales teams and depot managers to drive both collection and commercial success.
- Comfortable juggling high-volume ledgers and competing priorities across multiple business entities with solid Excel skills and a sharp eye for detail.

To find out more about this opportunity, please contact Ben at MacKenzie King.
